scope.notes: Metadata and author-reported evidence from primary sources; no experiments reproduced. NLS validation is distinguished from transfer proposals.

urban.title: Unveiling the optimization process of physics informed neural networks: How accurate and competitive can PINNs be?
urban.access_level: Peer-reviewed; author manuscript and full arXiv v3 HTML inspected
urban.evidence: Direct cubic-NLS test. Table 5: two hidden layers of 40 neurons with self-scaled Broyden and MSE achieve real/imaginary relative L2 errors (5±1,8±2)e-6. Hard initial conditions and periodic coordinate features used.
urban.limitations: Domain expands from earlier benchmark ±5 to ±15; constraints, model size and training also change. Cross-paper improvement cannot be attributed solely to the optimizer. Initial sech profile is not exactly periodic; enlarged window reduces boundary-tail mismatch. No verified Dysthe test.
urban.explicit_future_work: Investigate modifications of limited-memory BFGS and their convergence in PINNs (section 6).

hardic.title: Stability in training PINNs for stiff PDEs: Why initial conditions matter
hardic.venue: Foundations of Data Science, early access
hardic.access_level: Peer-reviewed early access; publisher abstract, indexed full text, tables and author repository inspected
hardic.evidence: Direct NLS ablation: real/imaginary relative L2 errors 1.80e-4 and 2.58e-4 with periodic boundaries, hard IC1, self-adaptive weights and mini-batching. Examines hard initial constraints with NTK analysis.
hardic.limitations: Hard trial-function construction is explicitly acknowledged as established. Results do not establish universal necessity of exact IC enforcement or superiority on Dysthe; hard enforcement of noisy inverse data requires care.
hardic.explicit_future_work: Publisher text discusses combining hard constraints with causal training, time marching, residual attention, curricula and co-training; detailed concluding outlook not independently inspected.

causal.title: Respecting causality for training physics-informed neural networks
causal.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 421, 116813
causal.access_level: Peer-reviewed; publisher abstract and accessible article sections inspected
causal.evidence: Causal residual weights delay emphasis on later evolution stages until preceding residuals decrease. Demonstrated on Lorenz, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky and Navier-Stokes.
causal.limitations: Transfer method rather than direct NLS/Dysthe evidence from this paper. For spatial Dysthe, causality follows propagation distance xi rather than retarded profile time tau.

pirate.title: PirateNets: Physics-informed Deep Learning with Residual Adaptive Networks
pirate.evidence: Residual gates initially yield a shallow effective architecture which gains depth during learning; Fourier features and physics-informed initialization improve trainability of network derivatives.
pirate.limitations: No NLS benchmark found in inspected full text. Proved residual-to-solution results concern specified linear elliptic/parabolic problems, not nonlinear NLS or Dysthe. Authors acknowledge substantial training cost.
pirate.explicit_future_work: Accelerate training with PDE-specific coordinate embeddings; extend physics-informed initialization to operator learning (section 6).

soap.title: Gradient Alignment in Physics-informed Neural Networks: A Second-Order Optimization Perspective
soap.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38, Main Conference
soap.evidence: Structured SOAP preconditioning mitigates gradient conflicts. Ten PDE benchmarks show reported 2–10x accuracy improvements; PirateNet is effective in studied architecture ablations.
soap.limitations: No NLS benchmark found in full text. Approximately 2x longer training than their baselines is explicitly reported. Cross-PDE accuracy gains do not establish NLS superiority or lower wall time.
soap.explicit_future_work: Develop more computationally efficient preconditioned algorithms that retain gradient-alignment benefits (conclusion).

optimizer.title: Optimizing the optimizer for physics-informed neural networks and Kolmogorov-Arnold networks
optimizer.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 446, 118308
optimizer.access_level: Peer-reviewed publication verified via publisher and author institution; updated arXiv abstract inspected, v6 2026-02-08
optimizer.evidence: Studies self-scaled BFGS/Broyden and line-search variants on Burgers, Allen-Cahn, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, Ginzburg-Landau and Stokes; also evaluates DeepONet.
optimizer.limitations: Listed evidence does not establish NLS or Dysthe performance. Later arXiv revision should not be conflated with the 2025 journal version. Dense curvature methods may incur substantial memory costs.

pino.title: Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Learning Partial Differential Equations
pino.access_level: Peer-reviewed; accepted-manuscript repository metadata and abstract inspected
pino.evidence: Combines coarse-resolution trajectory data with finer-resolution PDE constraints to learn parametric solution operators, rather than one trajectory.
pino.limitations: Application to the approved spatial water-wave Dysthe equation remains a proposed transfer. Cost accounting must include reference-data generation and training; output-resolution transfer is distinct from accuracy on unseen physical spectra.

pinnacle.title: PINNacle: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Solving PDEs
pinnacle.access_level: Peer-reviewed; proceedings manuscript and author code repository inspected
pinnacle.evidence: More than 20 PDEs and approximately ten PINN methods permit systematic comparisons across geometry, nonlinearity and multiscale difficulty.
pinnacle.limitations: Not an NLS-specific leaderboard. Does not establish a universal best PINN or superiority over classical solvers. Benchmark recipes must be adapted transparently to the approved water-wave equation.
pinnacle.explicit_future_work: Highlights domain decomposition and loss reweighting for multiscale problems and complex geometries.

soap_moq.title: Momentum-Accelerated Structured Preconditioning for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
soap_moq.access_level: Workshop status verified on author institution page; abstract and manuscript search extract inspected
soap_moq.evidence: Preliminary SOAP+MoQ comparison across multiple seeds for viscous Burgers, Poisson and Kovasznay flow; explores effects of gradient noise and batch reuse.
soap_moq.limitations: Not verified main-conference publication and no NLS case. Preliminary evidence does not justify ranking above established strong baselines.

spectral.title: Spectral informed neural networks
spectral.venue: Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics 477, 117178
spectral.access_level: Peer-reviewed publication metadata and indexed publisher abstract/sections inspected. Direct publisher retrieval restricted. Author identities and journal DOI independently verified on primary arXiv record 2408.16414.
spectral.evidence: Frequency inputs and spectral-coefficient outputs replace spatial automatic differentiation by multiplication. Authors report reduced memory and training expense in their evaluated PDEs.
spectral.limitations: No NLS/Dysthe validation established by this metadata check. Issue date is May 2026, while arXiv lists journal year 2025 and the original preprint appeared August 2024. Do not describe the underlying idea as first introduced in 2026.

goal.title: Goal oriented error estimation for adaptive sampling of PINNS
goal.access_level: Primary arXiv metadata and abstract inspected; journal or conference acceptance not verified
goal.evidence: Uses dual-weighted-residual ideas to estimate goal-functional error and guide importance sampling for PINNs and Deep Ritz on the Laplace equation.
goal.limitations: This is elliptic Laplace evidence, not NLS/Dysthe or extreme-event prediction. Generic goal-oriented PINN sampling is already prior art; proposed wave applications need their own contribution and validation.

operatorbudget.title: Operator-Budget Evaluation of Residual-Adaptive Sampling in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
operatorbudget.access_level: Peer-reviewed publisher metadata, indexed full article and abstract inspected; direct open returned rate limit
operatorbudget.evidence: Charges proposal-maintenance and training residual evaluations in a shared work ledger. Studies cached residual proposal maintenance and joint cost-accuracy criteria.
operatorbudget.limitations: Selected manufactured/low-dimensional PDE suite, not NLS/Dysthe. Authors explicitly do not establish universal superiority of cache writeback. Residual-call counts complement rather than replace wall-time and memory measurements.
